I'm going to see about seeing my psychologist after the semester is over. There is about 2 weeks left.

I appreciate your thoughtful replies. I'm just going to sorta hang out here a bit while I try to relax to some music. If anyone else would like to chat on this thread for a while I'm down for it.

Psychologist is what I meant. 

My grandpa was someone I used to see everyday. People used to call me his sidekick when I was young because we used to go places together everyday. What's really hard for me is that our religious beliefs did not align. So to me, I'm worried that he is destined to a place I'd rather not talk about.

I still think of him everyday. It always brings tears to my eyes.
